name: News Desk
description: Publisher feeds grouped into stories and ranked by freshness, coverage and your follows: top stories, sections, full coverage, followed topics, saved articles and feed health.
author: Vakyartha

web__fetch_page.reason: Read your selected publisher feeds and article pages.

tools.name: get_latest_articles
tools.description: Ranked News Desk stories, each with its lead headline, link, publishers and why it ranks; filter by section or by a topic query

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. World, Business, Technology, Science, National)

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (1-50, default 10)

query.description: Optional topic: every word must appear in a headline, excerpt or publisher tag (e.g. RBI, TCS, Chandrayaan)

tools.name: get_bulletin
tools.description: A radio-style news bulletin in spoken sentences from the ranked stories, with the stories it covers and the same bulletin as a programme (segments with pictures) that another app can publish at its voice.listen path to play or watch; optionally for one section, topic or channel

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. World, Business, Technology, Science, National)

query.description: Optional topic: every word must appear in a headline, excerpt or publisher tag (e.g. RBI, TCS, Chandrayaan)

channel.description: Radio channel: top, foryou (the user's follows and reading habits), section:<name> or topic:<followed topic>

tools.name: get_story_coverage
tools.description: Full coverage of the best-ranked story matching a topic: every publisher's report in time order with links, and a spoken report

query.description: Words naming the story (a person, place, company or event)

skills.name: news-desk-reader
skills.description: Search, inspect, and summarize verified publisher articles and current headlines from News Desk
